content.introduction: The United States Inflation Rate increased to 3.70 percent in September from 3.40 percent in August of 2026, according to Trading Economics and U.S. Labor Department data. The core inflation rate, excluding food and energy, was 2.4% in August 2026. The annual inflation rate was 3.7% for the 12 months ending September 2026, up from 3.4% in August, with a monthly increase of 0.6%.

Inflation Rate in the United States is expected to be 3.40 percent by the end of this quarter, according to Trading Economics global macro models and analysts expectations. [...] ## The US annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.7% in September 2026, up from 3.4% in each of the previous two months and above market expectations of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Gasoline rose 34.2% yoy, more than 27.4% in August and fuel oil prices increased 74.2%, compared with 52% previously.
